name: io.github.rubatoyd/nl-openapi-mcp
description: National Library of Korea holdings search - books, online materials, KDC classification

environmentVariables.name: NL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: National Library of Korea OpenAPI key (issued at www.nl.go.kr). Required.

environmentVariables.name: NL_OS_TRUST
environmentVariables.description: Use the OS trust store for TLS (1=on, default). Set 0 to disable. Needed on school/corporate networks that intercept SSL.
